newsitem.title: USA: Nextwave Telecom IPO not yet scheduled - Merrill.
newsitem.headline: Nextwave Telecom IPO not yet scheduled - Merrill.

text.p: The initial public offering of Nextwave Telecom Inc has not been scheduled, lead underwriter Merrill Lynch & Co said Friday.
The deal is "to be announced," Merrill said.
Nextwave filed in June for a $300 million IPO of Class B common stock under the proposed symbol "SURF".

Earlier this week, the San Diego company announced a 10-year wireless resale deal with MCI Communications Corp. The pact allows MCI to connect its network to NextWave's planned national Personal Communications Services system, giving MCI the capacity to offer PCS service to more than 100 million individuals in 63 markets, including 29 of the top 50 markets.
